data.narrative:
Liminal Insights is a Series A climate and energy technology company founded by Barry Van Tassell and Shaurjo Biswas, having raised $38.9M to date. The valuation universe for this stage and sector includes 1 public comparable (LNZA) and 8 private peers including Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, and KoBold Metals, though no sufficiently close peer subset exists at identical stage and valuation tier.

Given data constraints, stage-progression methodology is the sole applicable triangulation approach. Using total capital raised ($39M) as a valuation proxy and applying a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A advancement yields an implied valuation of $78M. This method rests on the assumption that capital deployment and the company's position within its funding lifecycle reasonably approximate current enterprise value.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $66M to $89M, centered on a median of $78M. This reflects a ±15% confidence band around the stage-progression result. Key uncertainties include the absence of tightly comparable peers at this stage within climate-tech, limiting calibration of the 2.0x multiplier to sector-specific progression patterns, and reliance on raised capital as a proxy absent disclosed revenue or explicit post-money terms from recent rounds. Additional diligence on unit economics, customer traction, and capital efficiency relative to peer cohorts would materially sharpen this range.
